title: WinMan: The Modern Window Manager and Workflow Accelerator for ImageJ/Fiji (v{{VERSION}})
description:
WinMan (Window Manager) v{{VERSION}} is a lightweight yet powerful utility plugin designed to streamline high-throughput microscopy workflows in ImageJ/Fiji. It addresses the "Desktop Explosion" problem common in bioimage analysis by acting as a digital housekeeper for your workspace.

v{{VERSION}} Release Highlights:
WinMan brings a commercial-grade user experience to the classic ImageJ environment:

  • 🧠 Smart "Invert" Logic: Introduces the "Keep Match" engine. Instead of closing windows one by one, you can now define what to keep (e.g., "Result") and instantly clear the rest of the clutter.
  • ⚡ High-Throughput Batch Tools: Features a zero-click "Auto Contrast All" algorithm that instantly applies intelligent histogram stretching to 50+ open images, perfect for 16-bit low-light fluorescence data.
  • 🎨 Modern Flat Interface: Replaces the traditional gray AWT look with a custom Flat Design (Swing) UI, optimized with a compact "Stick-supported" layout to maximize screen real estate.
  • 🛡️ System Health Monitor: Integrates a live Memory Bar and one-click Garbage Collection (GC) to prevent memory overflows during heavy analysis sessions.

Key Features:

  • 🔍 Granular Filtering: Case-insensitive string matching for precise window targeting.
  • 📐 Layout Automation: Improved algorithms for Tile and Cascade window arrangements.
  • 🚀 Workflow Acceleration: One-click global Reset Zoom to standardize viewports.
  • 🔒 Data Safety: Built-in confirmation dialogs for destructive actions (e.g., "Close All") to prevent accidental data loss.
